Hello Marissa and Elena,

Thanks for the report. We investigated case #789432 and here are the preliminary findings:

- Between 2027-05-25T00:00Z and 2027-05-27T23:59Z a subset of metering records from the EU region experienced delayed delivery due to transient throttling on the aggregation pipeline for the marketplace product family.
- Delayed records were backfilled in an asynchronous job on 2027-05-30 02:18Z and should be visible in the "Marketplace Usage Report" for May as a separate backfill batch.
- The backfill uses a different aggregation window and can lead to a short-lived mismatch in daily interim exports.

Action items we've completed:
1) Marked the backfill batch in the AWS report and flagged the job id: backfill-EU-20270530-02.
2) Escalated to the metering ingestion team to provide a reconciled export. The reconciled supplier export is scheduled for 2027-05-31 16:00Z UTC.
3) If you need an invoice adjustment or pro-rated credit, open a Billing Adjustment request and reference Case #789432; we'll fast-track review since this was a provider-side ingestion delay.

Link to case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/cases/789432

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Operations

Elena —

Quick update after AWS confirmation: the missing records were a provider-side aggregation delay and AWS has backfilled the data (they've scheduled a reconciled export for today at 16:00Z). Our internal check (Jonas/Karthik) also shows Redwood received the original events in our ingestion tier; the discrepancy is in how interim daily exports omitted delayed records until the backfill.

Proposed path forward:
- BrightLayer: please hold any immediate collections actions affecting May invoices until we confirm the reconciled export and the final AWS Marketplace report (expected within 24 hours).
- Redwood: if the reconciled export results in a positive delta on your May usage, we'll prepare a pro-rated credit for the underreported portion and include VAT treatment notes (Monica will confirm how to label it for EU VAT).
- AWS: please provide the reconciled CSV and a short statement confirming provider-side delay for audit records (we'll attach it to the credit memo).

I expect to have the reconciled numbers by EOB Tuesday (2027-06-01 UTC); if anything shifts I will escalate. Thanks for the quick collaboration — I know month-end billing is painful for finance teams.

Next steps: Jonas will share a short reconciled diff and Monica will outline any collection hold text BrightLayer should use in customer-facing communications.
